GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG311.7 (16 Oct 45) CI
(SCAPIN-150)
16 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Radio News Service for Naval Ships
The request of the Japanese Government for permission to send the radio news to repatriation vessels, dated 13 October 1945, is granted subject to complete pre-censorship of all broadcast by Civil Censorship Detachment.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.

WARCOS (3)
